title: Define release transition and recovery schemas
description:
Versioned machine contracts define every release transition and durable recovery identity before workflow implementations consume them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Candidate handoff/completion, candidate root, escrow, rehearsal, final-tag, npm, GHCR, final-GitHub, and compact tag-manifest schemas carry exact run, artifact, release, asset, digest, parent, repository, actor, workflow, and source identities.
- [hard] REQ-02: Prepared, completed, recovery-completed, superseded, and irreversible boundaries are explicit; exact-ID readers reject foreign, expired, substituted, or inconsistent records and listings are never authoritative.
- [hard] REQ-03: Schema fixtures cover crash boundaries and Actions-410 reconstruction from immutable escrow, tag manifest, and exact live state without authorizing rebuild or replacement.

## Notes

Blast radius: release protocol schemas, readers, and schema fixtures only; no mutating workflow or public channel operation.
